resources.string: Speed++ (24″ wheel setting)

Sets your bike to 24″ wheels. It then counts 84% of the real speed and cuts assist only at about 29.7\u00A0km/h (EU) or 38\u00A0km/h (US). YABA shows you the real speed everywhere; the bike’s own speedo shows less.
Turn on Speed++
Back to 28″
On. YABA multiplies the bike’s speed by 1.1875.
While it is on, the bike’s odometer counts about 16% too little.
YABA reads the wheel size when it connects to the bike.
YABA could not read the wheel size.
Read wheel size
Speed++ only works on bikes with 28″ wheels from the factory.
Wheel size %1$d″
Only while standing: the bike passes the wheel size to the motor controller.
The bike did not take the wheel size.
28″ stock
24″ Speed++
Wheel size from the factory
Your bike is set to 24″ wheels right now. YABA cannot tell whether it left the factory as an S3 with 28″ wheels or as an X3 with 24″ wheels. Your answer decides which speed YABA shows.

The bike did not report its wheel size this time either.
Your bike is set to 28″ wheels but left the factory with 24″. It then shows more speed than it rides and cuts assist earlier. YABA shows you the real speed.
Back to 24″
YABA does not know the factory wheel size yet, so it shows the speed as your bike reports it. You can set it under %1$s › %2$s.
